seaweed.x: Seaweed is a [[foraging|forageable]] that can be found in the ocean.
The quality of seaweed can be increased at the [[oracle-chamber|Oracle Chamber]] to improve the quality of [[farm-animal|ocean animal]] produce.
Seaweed can be gathered by cutting sea grass with a [[scythe|scythe]] while [[diving|diving]], in any area.
The [[oracle-chamber|Oracle Chamber]] offers upgrades to the player's [[ocean-crops|ocean crop]] seeds and seaweed. Each upgrade requires ocean animal produce at a specific quality and game money.

Upgrades purchased at the Oracle Chamber apply to all seaweed in the player's inventory or planted on the farm and all future seaweed purchases with no increase in price. Once upgraded, there will be higher chance in getting higher quality of all ocean animal produce.
